purpose: Causal, non-fabricated temporal reconstruction with evidence reuse.
use: Reconstructing what happened and why, or recording a material event: keep causal, non-fabricated history and reuse evidence.
semantic_conditions: Never fabricate past times or transitions; reuse evidence by reference.
mandatory_preconditions: Actual event evidence and causal references.
postconditions_verification: History reconstructible without duplicate or invented records.
